overview: Rockhopper Caves are the heart of hopper activity in Dawnshroud Peaks.
details: Generations of migrations carved these tunnels. Grimlings frequently raid the warrens, and volcanic vents create unstable chambers.
hooks: A massive hopper migration is about to begin.
Grimlings attempt to seize a hopper nesting chamber.
Volcanic vents destabilize a major warren tunnel.
A rare albino hopper is sighted deep within the caves.
